items.title: fix: set container daemon socket to "-" if the default socket is not available
items.body:
Fixes https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/issues/1073

I stumbled across this since migrating to podman.

I saw the stale PR https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/pulls/1090 and followed the discussion. The comment https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/pulls/1090#issuecomment-63710 makes a lot of sense and I implemented the fix accordingly.

items.title: feat: merge NanoCPUs into job containers (--cpus honored)
items.body:
mergeJobOptions dropped the parsed --cpus value. This PR merges it with
the same guard semantics as --memory (a workflow may not exceed a runner
config limit when set).
